mapper.select: SELECT CAST(rc.document_id AS varchar) AS document_id, CAST(rc.id AS varchar) AS chunk_id, rd.title AS source_title, rc.chunk_text AS content, 1 - (rc.embedding_vector <=> CAST(#{queryVector} AS vector)) AS score FROM public.rag_chunk rc JOIN public.rag_document rd ON rd.id = rc.document_id WHERE rd.deleted = FALSE AND rd.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rd.assistant_code = #{assistantCode} AND rc.embedding_vector IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rc.embedding_vector <=> CAST(#{queryVector} AS vector) LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT CAST(rc.document_id AS varchar) AS document_id, CAST(rc.id AS varchar) AS chunk_id, rd.title AS source_title, rc.chunk_text AS content, ts_rank(rc.chunk_tsv, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword})) AS score FROM public.rag_chunk rc JOIN public.rag_document rd ON rd.id = rc.document_id WHERE rd.deleted = FALSE AND rd.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rd.assistant_code = #{assistantCode} AND rc.chunk_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword}) ORDER BY ts_rank(rc.chunk_tsv, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword})) DESC LIMIT #{topK}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_chunk ( document_id, chunk_no, chunk_text, chunk_text_norm, token_count, char_count, page_from, page_to, section_title, metadata_json, embedding_json, embedding_vector, created_at, updated_at, assistant_code, ) VALUES ( #{documentId}, #{chunkNo}, #{chunkText}, #{chunkTextNorm}, #{tokenCount}, #{charCount}, #{pageFrom}, #{pageTo}, #{sectionTitle}, CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{embeddingJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{embeddingVector} AS vector), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{assistantCode} )

INSERT INTO rag_chunk ( document_id, chunk_no, chunk_text, chunk_text_norm, token_count, char_count, page_from, page_to, section_title, metadata_json, embedding_json, embedding_vector, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{item.documentId}, #{item.chunkNo}, #{item.chunkText}, #{item.chunkTextNorm}, #{item.tokenCount}, #{item.charCount}, #{item.pageFrom}, #{item.pageTo}, #{item.sectionTitle}, CAST(#{item.metadataJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{item.embeddingJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{item.embeddingVector} AS vector), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
